classification.difficultyReason: The hardest container requires tracking a constant-width section, an abrupt widening and subsequent narrowing, then matching these to constant, reduced and increasing graph gradients using the taught cross-section rule.

content.prompt: For each container, select the graph that best describes the height of the water as it is poured at a constant rate into the container.

spec.description: Unshaded upright cylinder at left, followed by three labelled qualitative graph choices in one comparison row. Rear bottom edge is dashed.
spec.mathematics: A: increasing with decreasing gradient. B: constant positive gradient. C: increasing S-shaped curve. All graphs have arrowed Height and Time axes without numerical scales.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph choices are permanent givens; the supplied answer B is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked: The cross-section is constant, so the water height increases at a constant rate. Correct answer: B.

spec.description: Unshaded cylindrical upper section with a downward-pointing conical base at left; its visible curved junction edge is retained. Three graph choices remain alongside it.
spec.mathematics: A: initially steep, decreasing gradient followed by a straight increasing segment. B: initially shallow, increasing gradient followed by a steep straight segment. C: straight increasing line.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph choices are permanent givens; the supplied answer A is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked: The conical base widens as the water rises, so the height initially increases at a decreasing rate. In the cylindrical section, the cross-section is constant and the height increases at a constant rate. Correct answer: A.

spec.description: Unshaded container with a narrow flat bottom and wider elliptical open top, followed by choices A, B and C.
spec.mathematics: A: straight decreasing line from a positive height to the time axis. B: increasing S-shaped curve. C: increasing curve with decreasing gradient throughout.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph choices are permanent givens; the supplied answer C is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked: The container widens upwards, so its cross-section increases as the water rises. The water height increases at a decreasing rate. Correct answer: C.

spec.description: Unshaded rounded container with a narrow elliptical opening. All three associated graph choices are in the same row.
spec.mathematics: A: horizontal at a positive height. B: increasing, initially steep, shallower through the middle and increasingly steep towards the end. C: three increasing straight segments with steep, shallow and steep gradients.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph choices are permanent givens; the supplied answer B is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked: The cross-section increases towards the middle, then decreases towards the opening. The height rises quickly at first, more slowly through the middle, then more quickly near the top, with the rate changing smoothly. Correct answer: B.

spec.description: Unshaded narrow cylindrical lower section beneath the broad base of an upper body that narrows towards an elliptical opening.
spec.mathematics: A: initial straight increasing segment, followed by a shallower curve whose gradient increases. B: initial straight segment, then a sharply steeper curve with decreasing gradient. C: shallow straight segment followed by a steeper straight segment.
spec.answerVisibility: Graph choices are permanent givens; the supplied answer A is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked: The narrow cylindrical section gives a constant rate of height increase. At the wider body, the rate drops; as that body narrows upwards, the height increases at an increasing rate. Correct answer: A.
